QUICK GUIDE

How to use QuizReel Studio

Make a quiz

Pick a Topic, set the number of items and the seconds per item, then choose Auto-generate quiz. You can edit the title and the items yourself. Write one item per line as Name|emoji.

Classic and New UI

The switch at the top of the left panel changes the style. Classic uses a style template and an animated background. New UI is the silhouette game with a refined background, game HUD and playful effects. Topic, items, photos and music are shared by both.

Long form and Short form

Use Short form for Shorts, Reels and TikTok (9:16). Use Long form for a normal wide video (16:9). The Safe zones button shows where app buttons cover a short video.

Voice-over

Open Voice-over auto-sync and choose one audio file with question 1, answer 1, question 2, answer 2 and so on, with a short pause between each. Choose Auto-cut & sync, check each clip, and drag the handles on the waveform to fix timing.

Photos and music

Add your own pictures named after the items, for example lion.jpg. Add your own music, or leave it empty to use the built-in beat.

Preview and render

The play button and scrubber control the preview. Press Space to play or pause. Render 4K & download records in real time, so keep the tab open and in front until it finishes.
